key_insight: HERD combines evolving external skills and bounded example memory with parameter distillation to acquire new capabilities while limiting forgetting.
engineering_relevance: HERD may inform continual updating of engineering AI assistants, but the abstract does not demonstrate solid-mechanics or constitutive-modeling applications.
method: Continually refine reusable skills in an external harness.
Retain high-residual examples not captured by skills in bounded memory.
Internalize experience through drift-constrained distillation with dual anchors.
evidence_signal: On the 25-stage TRACE+17 task stream under fixed memory and compute budgets, HERD matches the strongest parametric baseline in new-task acquisition while reporting the least forgetting and strongest general-capability retention.
watch_item: Transfer to mechanics workflows remains untested in the abstract and would require domain-specific validation.
paper_title: HERD: Harness-Evolving Recursive Distillation for Continual Learning
